name: FilX – WordPress Blog & Post Filter Plugin by Category, Tag & Taxonomy
author: Akshar Addons

sections.description:
FilX – WordPress Blog & Post Filter Plugin by Category, Tag & Taxonomy lets you create dynamic post filters for your WordPress website. Visitors can easily filter blog posts and post grids by category, tag, or custom taxonomy using AJAX without refreshing the page. Display filtered posts with a seamless browsing experience using the dedicated Elementor widget, Gutenberg block, WordPress widget, or shortcode. FilX Premium extends filtering capabilities with tag, custom taxonomy, and custom post type support.

Use FilX to add flexible post filtering to your blog homepage, landing pages, sidebars, or any content area. Select categories, tags, or taxonomies, customize filter styles, and display matching posts in responsive layouts. Enhance navigation with AJAX-powered filtering and Load More functionality, making it easier for visitors to discover relevant content.

🔗 Product Links

Buy Now | Live Demo | Documentation | Support Request

🚀 Key Features

  • ✅ AJAX-powered category filtering without page reloads.
  • ↔️ Previous/Next AJAX pagination in the free version.
  • 🧩 Responsive WordPress post tabs and post grid layouts.
  • 🎨 Custom heading, category tab, and post title colors.
  • 🖼️ Post image display with responsive templates.
  • 📱 Multiple widget instances for sidebars and content areas.
  • 🧱 Native Gutenberg block and Elementor tabs widget support.
  • 🔗 Shortcode support for pages, posts, and templates.
  • 🔎 Category selection from the widget settings.
  • 📱 Mobile-friendly and responsive post filtering layouts.

🧩 Shortcode

[categoryposttab template="pane_style_2" number_of_post_display="8"]

🎯 Perfect For

  • Blog homepages and category landing pages.
  • Custom taxonomy or tag pages.
  • News and magazine websites.
  • Content hubs with multiple post categories.
  • Sidebars and compact post navigation areas.

🔧 How FilX Works

  1. Edit a page or post.
  2. In Gutenberg, add a Shortcode block. In Elementor or a supported page builder, add a shortcode element.
  3. Paste [categoryposttab template="pane_style_2" number_of_post_display="8"]
  4. Select categories, choose the tab layout, and configure the display settings.
  5. Publish the page and let visitors switch tabs with AJAX.

💡 Why Choose FilX?

FilX makes WordPress content discovery easier with AJAX-powered post filtering and responsive category tabs. Visitors can quickly explore blog posts without refreshing the page. Whether you run a blog, news website, magazine, or content hub, FilX provides flexible filtering options to organize and display relevant posts using categories, tags, and custom taxonomies.

⭐ Premium Features

Upgrade for advanced tab filtering and display controls:

  • ⚡ Load More and numeric AJAX pagination for seamless post browsing.
  • 🧱 Custom post type support.
  • 🧱 Elementor widget and Gutenberg block controls for premium settings.
  • 🔎 Advanced filtering options for categories, tags and custom taxonomies.
  • 🎨 Additional templates with list, grid, and hover animation layouts.
  • 🖼️ Controls for image size, post title, excerpt, pagination, and read more link.
  • ↕️ Sort categories and posts by title or ID in ascending or descending order.
  • 👁️ Show or hide post counts, empty categories, dates, comments, and author details.
  • ⭐ Open a selected category by default or add an All tab.
  • ↔️ RTL support and adjustable spacing between post items.
  • 🔗 Dynamic multiple shortcode creation for content areas.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Edit a page or post and add a Gutenberg Shortcode block, Elementor shortcode element, or supported page builder shortcode element.
  4. Paste [categoryposttab template="pane_style_2" number_of_post_display="8"], select categories, configure the tab layout, and publish the page.
sections.faq:
Can I filter WordPress posts by tags and custom taxonomies?

Yes. FilX Premium supports filtering posts by tags and custom taxonomies, providing more advanced content filtering options.

Does FilX support AJAX Load More?

Yes. FilX Premium includes AJAX Load More functionality, allowing visitors to load additional posts without refreshing the page.

Does FilX support custom post types?

Yes. FilX Premium supports custom post types, allowing you to display and filter different types of WordPress content.

Can I customize the post layouts?

Yes. FilX offers multiple responsive templates, including list and grid layouts, with customizable colors, images, titles, and other display settings.

Does FilX support category filtering in the free version?

Yes. The free version allows visitors to filter WordPress posts by category using AJAX.

Does FilX support numeric AJAX pagination?

Yes. FilX Premium supports numeric AJAX pagination, allowing visitors to navigate through additional posts without refreshing the page.
